title: Two Sentry envelope tests can miss a new item type or a captured event
evidence: chat-edits-sentry-envelope.test.ts asserts the item types sent are exactly ['event'], so a session, client_report, transaction or feedback item fails before the event-only blanking; api.chat-run-roadmap.test.ts asserts the run_roadmap turn sends no envelope, so a captured event cannot hide behind unblanked timestamps. Both proved by injecting an extra item and an extra event (PR body). From the PR 1381 review (2026-11-12).
